this.evalPathCommands(stmt.commands, pathLocals, trans, drawCommands, locals);\n\n        this.pushDrawCmd({ type: \"Path\", commands: drawCommands, style });\n        return null;\n      }\n      case \"Group\": {\n        let localTrans = Transform2D.identity();\n        if (stmt.pos) {\n          const [tx, ty] = this.asVec2(this.evalExpr(stmt.pos, locals));\n          localTrans.tx = tx;\n          localTrans.ty = ty;\n        }\n        if (stmt.rot) {\n          const angle = this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(stmt.rot, locals));\n          const cos = Math.cos(angle);\n          const sin = Math.sin(angle);\n          localTrans = localTrans.mul(new Transform2D(cos, sin, -sin, cos, 0, 0));\n        }\n        if (stmt.scale) {\n          const [sx, sy] = this.asVec2(this.evalExpr(stmt.scale, locals));\n          localTrans = localTrans.mul(new Transform2D(sx, 0, 0, sy, 0, 0));\n        }\n\n        const newTrans = this.currentTransform().mul(localTrans);\n        this.transformStack.push(newTrans);\n\n        const style = this.currentStyle();\n        if (stmt.fill) style.fill = this.asPaint(this.evalExpr(stmt.fill, locals));\n        if (stmt.stroke) style.stroke = this.asPaint(this.evalExpr(stmt.stroke, locals));\n        if (stmt.opacity) style.opacity *= this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(stmt.opacity, locals));\n        if (stmt.blend) style.blend = this.evalBlend(this.evalExpr(stmt.blend, locals));\n        if (stmt.blur) style.blur = Math.max(0, this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(stmt.blur, locals)));\n        if (stmt.shadow) style.shadow = this.evalShadow(stmt.shadow, locals);\n        if (stmt.glow) style.glow = this.evalGlow(stmt.glow, locals);\n        this.styleStack.push(style);\n\n        for (const bStmt of stmt.body) {\n          this.evalStmt(bStmt, locals);\n        }\n\n        this.styleStack.pop();\n        this.transformStack.pop();\n        return null;\n      }\n      case \"Sprite\": {\n        // Section 18.3: palette-indexed pixel art; ignores the inherited fill/stroke.\n        const posRaw = this.asVec2(this.evalExpr(stmt.pos, locals));\n        const palette: PvgColor[] = [];\n        for (const entry of stmt.palette) {\n          palette.push(this.asColor(this.evalExpr(entry, locals)));\n        }\n        const scale = stmt.scale ? Math.max(0.01, this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(stmt.scale, locals))) : 1.0;\n        const style = this.currentStyle();\n        style.fill = solidPaint(PvgColor.White());\n        style.stroke = solidPaint(PvgColor.None());\n        if (stmt.opacity) style.opacity *= this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(stmt.opacity, locals));\n        if (stmt.blend) style.blend = this.evalBlend(this.evalExpr(stmt.blend, locals));\n\n        const pos = this.snapPoint(this.currentTransform().transformPoint(posRaw));\n        this.pushDrawCmd({ type: \"Sprite\", pos, palette, rows: stmt.rows, scale, style });\n        return null;\n      }\n      case \"Spline\": {\n        // Section 18.5: Catmull-Rom data spline (stroke-only).\n        const raw = this.evalExpr(stmt.points, locals);\n        const items: Value[] = isArrayValue(raw) ? raw : [];\n        const ctrl: Vec2[] = [];\n        const hasVec = items.some((v) => Array.isArray(v));\n        if (hasVec) {\n          for (const v of items) {\n            if (Array.isArray(v)) {\n              if (v.length === 2 && typeof v[0] === \"number\" && typeof v[1] === \"number\") {\n                ctrl.push([v[0], v[1]]);\n              } else {\n                throw new Error(\"Spline points must be [x, y] vectors or numbers.\");\n              }\n            } else if (typeof v === \"number\") {\n              ctrl.push([ctrl.length, v]);\n            } else {\n              throw new Error(\"Spline points must be [x, y] vectors or numbers.\");\n            }\n          }\n        } else {\n          const n = items.length;\n          if (n === 0) throw new Error(\"Spline requires at least one point.\");\n          const nums = items.map((v) => this.asNumber(v));\n          const [ox, oy] = stmt.pos\n            ? this.asVec2(this.evalExpr(stmt.pos, locals))\n            : ([0.0, 0.0] as Vec2);\n          const [sw, sh] = stmt.size\n            ? this.asVec2(this.evalExpr(stmt.size, locals))\n            : ([Math.max(2, n) - 1, 1] as Vec2);\n          let lo = Infinity;\n          let hi = -Infinity;\n          for (const v of nums) {\n            lo = Math.min(lo, v);\n            hi = Math.max(hi, v);\n          }\n          if (!(hi > lo)) hi = lo + 1.0;\n          for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            // y is down-positive: the MAX value sits at the top.\n            const t = n > 1 ? i / (n - 1) : 0.0;\n            const y = oy + (1.0 - (nums[i] - lo) / (hi - lo)) * sh;\n            ctrl.push([ox + t * sw, y]);\n          }\n        }\n        if (ctrl.length === 1) ctrl.push([ctrl[0][0], ctrl[0][1]]);\n\n        const style = this.currentStyle();\n        style.stroke = stmt.stroke\n          ? this.asPaint(this.evalExpr(stmt.stroke, locals))\n          : solidPaint(PvgColor.White());\n        style.fill = solidPaint(PvgColor.None());\n        if (stmt.width) style.width = this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(stmt.width, locals));\n        if (stmt.opacity) style.opacity *= this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(stmt.opacity, locals));\n        this.applyFxProps(style, stmt, locals);\n\n        const trans = this.currentTransform();\n        const points: Vec2[] = ctrl.map((p) => this.snapPoint(trans.transformPoint(p)));\n        this.pushDrawCmd({ type: \"Spline\", points, style });\n        return null;\n      }\n      case \"Clip\": {\n        // Evaluate mask in isolation (side-effect free), then content normally.\n        const base = this.drawList.length;\n        const scratch = new Map(locals);\n        this.evalStmt(stmt.mask, scratch);\n        if (this.drawList.length !== base + 1) {\n          this.drawList.length = base;\n          throw new Error(\"Clip mask must produce exactly one shape.\");\n        }\n        const mask = this.drawList.pop()!;\n        const contentBase = this.drawList.length;\n        for (const bStmt of stmt.content) {\n          this.evalStmt(bStmt, locals);\n        }\n        const content = this.drawList.splice(contentBase);\n        this.pushDrawCmd({ type: \"Clip\", mask, content });\n        return null;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Post-0.2 Section 18.6: evaluates `path` body items — geometry commands, `set`\n   * (shared with the enclosing scope), and `for`/`while`/`if` control flow that\n   * shares the path's locals. Mirrors `eval_path_command` in the Rust core.\n   */\n  private evalPathCommands(\n    commands: PathCommandAst[],\n    pathLocals: Map<string, Value>,\n    trans: Transform2D,\n    drawCommands: DrawPathCommand[],\n    locals: Map<string, Value>\n  ): void {\n    for (const cmd of commands) {\n      switch (cmd.cmd) {\n        case \"Set\": {\n          const val = this.evalExpr(cmd.expr, pathLocals);\n          pathLocals.set(cmd.name, val);\n          locals.set(cmd.name, val);\n          break;\n        }\n        case \"Start\": {\n          const pt = this.snapPoint(trans.transformPoint(this.asVec2(this.evalExpr(cmd.pt, pathLocals))));\n          drawCommands.push({ cmd: \"Start\", pt });\n          break;\n        }\n        case \"Line\": {\n          const pt = this.snapPoint(trans.transformPoint(this.asVec2(this.evalExpr(cmd.pt, pathLocals))));\n          drawCommands.push({ cmd: \"Line\", pt });\n          break;\n        }\n        case \"Quad\": {\n          const cp = this.snapPoint(trans.transformPoint(this.asVec2(this.evalExpr(cmd.cp, pathLocals))));\n          const ep = this.snapPoint(trans.transformPoint(this.asVec2(this.evalExpr(cmd.ep, pathLocals))));\n          drawCommands.push({ cmd: \"Quad\", cp, ep });\n          break;\n        }\n        case \"Curve\": {\n          const c1 = this.snapPoint(trans.transformPoint(this.asVec2(this.evalExpr(cmd.c1, pathLocals))));\n          const c2 = this.snapPoint(trans.transformPoint(this.asVec2(this.evalExpr(cmd.c2, pathLocals))));\n          const ep = this.snapPoint(trans.transformPoint(this.asVec2(this.evalExpr(cmd.ep, pathLocals))));\n          drawCommands.push({ cmd: \"Curve\", c1, c2, ep });\n          break;\n        }\n        case \"Arc\": {\n          const center = this.snapPoint(trans.transformPoint(this.asVec2(this.evalExpr(cmd.center, pathLocals))));\n          const radius = this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(cmd.radius, pathLocals));\n          const startAngle = this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(cmd.startAngle, pathLocals));\n          const endAngle = this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(cmd.endAngle, pathLocals));\n          drawCommands.push({ cmd: \"Arc\", center, radius, startAngle, endAngle });\n          break;\n        }\n        case \"Close\":\n          drawCommands.push({ cmd: \"Close\" });\n          break;\n        case \"For\": {\n          const startVal = this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(cmd.from, pathLocals));\n          const endVal = this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(cmd.to, pathLocals));\n          const stepVal = cmd.step\n            ? this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(cmd.step, pathLocals))\n            : endVal >= startVal\n              ? 1.0\n              : -1.0;\n          if (stepVal === 0.0) throw new Error(\"For loop step cannot be 0\");\n          let current = startVal;\n          while ((stepVal > 0.0 && current <= endVal) || (stepVal < 0.0 && current >= endVal)) {\n            this.loopCount++;\n            if (this.loopCount > this.loopLimit) {\n              throw new Error(`Exceeded safety loop limit of ${this.loopLimit} iterations`);\n            }\n            pathLocals.set(cmd.varName, current);\n            this.evalPathCommands(cmd.body, pathLocals, trans, drawCommands, locals);\n            current += stepVal;\n          }\n          break;\n        }\n        case \"While\": {\n          while (this.isTruthy(this.evalExpr(cmd.cond, pathLocals))) {\n            this.loopCount++;\n            if (this.loopCount > this.loopLimit) {\n              throw new Error(`Exceeded safety loop limit of ${this.loopLimit} iterations`);\n            }\n            this.evalPathCommands(cmd.body, pathLocals, trans, drawCommands, locals);\n          }\n          break;\n        }\n        case \"If\": {\n          const body = this.isTruthy(this.evalExpr(cmd.cond, pathLocals)) ? cmd.thenBody : cmd.elseBody;\n          this.evalPathCommands(body, pathLocals, trans, drawCommands, locals);\n          break;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // ---- PVG 0.2 style helpers ----\n  private evalCap(v: Value): LineCap {\n    const s = String(this.asString(v)).toLowerCase();\n    if (s === \"round\") return \"round\";\n    if (s === \"square\") return \"square\";\n    return \"butt\";\n  }\n\n  private evalJoin(v: Value): LineJoin {\n    const s = String(this.asString(v)).toLowerCase();\n    if (s === \"round\") return \"round\";\n    if (s === \"bevel\") return \"bevel\";\n    return \"miter\";\n  }\n\n  private evalStrokeAlign(v: Value): StrokeAlign {\n    const s = String(this.asString(v)).toLowerCase();\n    if (s === \"inside\") return \"inside\";\n    if (s === \"outside\") return \"outside\";\n    return \"center\";\n  }\n\n  private evalBlend(v: Value): BlendMode {\n    const s = String(this.asString(v)).toLowerCase();\n    if (s === \"add\") return \"add\";\n    if (s === \"multiply\") return \"multiply\";\n    if (s === \"screen\") return \"screen\";\n    if (s === \"overlay\") return \"overlay\";\n    return \"normal\";\n  }\n\n  private evalDash(items: Expr[] | null, locals: Map<string, Value>): number[] {\n    const out: number[] = [];\n    for (const d of items || []) {\n      const v = this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(d, locals));\n      if (v > 0 && Number.isFinite(v)) out.push(v);\n    }\n    return out;\n  }\n\n  private evalShadow(node: ShadowExpr, locals: Map<string, Value>): Shadow {\n    const offset = this.asVec2(this.evalExpr(node.offset, locals));\n    const radius = Math.max(0, this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(node.radius, locals)));\n    const color = this.asColor(this.evalExpr(node.color, locals));\n    return { offset, radius, color };\n  }\n\n  private evalGlow(node: GlowExpr, locals: Map<string, Value>): Glow {\n    const radius = Math.max(0, this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(node.radius, locals)));\n    const color = this.asColor(this.evalExpr(node.color, locals));\n    return { radius, color };\n  }\n\n  private applyFxProps(\n    style: DrawStyle,\n    stmt: Partial<ShapeFx>,\n    locals: Map<string, Value>,\n    isText = false\n  ): void {\n    if (stmt.cap && !isText) style.cap = this.evalCap(this.evalExpr(stmt.cap, locals));\n    if (stmt.join && !isText) style.join = this.evalJoin(this.evalExpr(stmt.join, locals));\n    if (stmt.miter && !isText) style.miter = Math.max(1, this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(stmt.miter, locals)));\n    if (stmt.dash && !isText) style.dash = this.evalDash(stmt.dash, locals);\n    if (stmt.align && !isText) style.strokeAlign = this.evalStrokeAlign(this.evalExpr(stmt.align, locals));\n    if (stmt.blur) style.blur = Math.max(0, this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(stmt.blur, locals)));\n    if (stmt.shadow) style.shadow = this.evalShadow(stmt.shadow, locals);\n    if (stmt.glow) style.glow = this.evalGlow(stmt.glow, locals);\n    if (stmt.blend) style.blend = this.evalBlend(this.evalExpr(stmt.blend, locals));\n  }\n\n  private invokeFunction(name: string, args: Value[]): Value {\n    if (this.callDepth >= MAX_CALL_STACK_DEPTH) {\n      throw new Error(`Exceeded call stack limit of ${MAX_CALL_STACK_DEPTH} frames`);\n    }\n    const func = this.functions.get(name);\n    if (!func) throw new Error(`Undefined function '${name}'`);\n    if (func.params.length !== args.length) {\n      throw new Error(`Function '${name}' expects ${func.params.length} arguments, got ${args.length}`);\n    }\n\n    const locals = new Map<string, Value>();\n    for (let i = 0; i < func.params.length; i++) {\n      locals.set(func.params[i], args[i]);\n    }\n\n    // Depth is released on every exit path (return value or error).\n    this.callDepth++;\n    try {\n      for (const stmt of func.body) {\n        const ret = this.evalStmt(stmt, locals);\n        if (ret && ret.isReturn) return ret.value;\n      }\n      return null;\n    } finally {\n      this.callDepth--;\n    }\n  }\n\n  private evalExpr(expr: Expr, locals: Map<string, Value>): Value {\n    switch (expr.type) {\n      case \"Number\": return expr.value;\n      case \"String\": return expr.value;\n      case \"Bool\": return expr.value;\n      case \"Color\": return expr.value;\n      case \"Vec2\": {\n        const x = this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(expr.x, locals));\n        const y = this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(expr.y, locals));\n        return [x, y];\n      }\n      case \"Array\": {\n        const out: Value[] = [];\n        for (const item of expr.items) out.push(this.evalExpr(item, locals));\n        return out;\n      }\n      case \"Pattern\": {\n        if (!this.patternNames.includes(expr.name)) {\n          throw new Error(`Unknown pattern '${expr.name}'`);\n        }\n        return { kind: \"pattern\", name: expr.name } satisfies Paint;\n      }\n      case \"Ident\": {\n        if (locals.has(expr.name)) return locals.get(expr.name)!;\n        if (this.globals.has(expr.name)) return this.globals.get(expr.name)!;\n        throw new Error(`Undefined variable '${expr.name}'`);\n      }\n      case \"Unary\": {\n        const op = expr.op;\n        const v = this.evalExpr(expr.inner, locals);\n        if (op === \"neg\") return -this.asNumber(v);\n        if (op === \"not\") return !this.isTruthy(v);\n        throw new Error(`Unknown unary operator '${String(op)}'`);\n      }\n      case \"Binary\": {\n        const op = expr.op;\n        const l = this.evalExpr(expr.left, locals);\n        const r = this.evalExpr(expr.right, locals);\n        switch (op) {\n          case \"+\": {\n            if (typeof l === \"string\" || typeof r === \"string\") {\n              return `${this.displayValue(l)}${this.displayValue(r)}`;\n            }\n            return this.asNumber(l) + this.asNumber(r);\n          }\n          case \"-\": return this.asNumber(l) - this.asNumber(r);\n          case \"*\": return this.asNumber(l) * this.asNumber(r);\n          case \"/\": {\n            const denom = this.asNumber(r);\n            return denom === 0.0 ? 0.0 : this.asNumber(l) / denom;\n          }\n          case \"%\": return this.asNumber(l) % this.asNumber(r);\n          case \"^\": return Math.pow(this.asNumber(l), this.asNumber(r));\n          // Equality and relational operators coerce via asNumber (numbers and\n          // bools only, mirroring Rust `as_f64`); any other type is a runtime\n          // error — e.g. `\"a\" == \"a\"` fails in both engines.\n          case \"==\": return this.asNumber(l) === this.asNumber(r);\n          case \"!=\": return this.asNumber(l) !== this.asNumber(r);\n          case \"<\": return this.asNumber(l) < this.asNumber(r);\n          case \"<=\": return this.asNumber(l) <= this.asNumber(r);\n          case \">\": return this.asNumber(l) > this.asNumber(r);\n          case \">=\": return this.asNumber(l) >= this.asNumber(r);\n          case \"and\": return this.isTruthy(l) && this.isTruthy(r);\n          case \"or\": return this.isTruthy(l) || this.isTruthy(r);\n          default:\n            throw new Error(`Unknown binary operator '${String(op)}'`);\n        }\n      }\n      case \"Ternary\":\n        return this.isTruthy(this.evalExpr(expr.cond, locals))\n          ? this.evalExpr(expr.trueBranch, locals)\n          : this.evalExpr(expr.falseBranch, locals);\n      case \"Call\": {\n        const args = expr.args.map((a) => this.evalExpr(a, locals));\n        switch (expr.name) {\n          case \"sin\": return Math.sin(this.asNumber(args[0]));\n          case \"cos\": return Math.cos(this.asNumber(args[0]));\n          case \"tan\": return Math.tan(this.asNumber(args[0]));\n          case \"sqrt\": return Math.sqrt(this.asNumber(args[0]));\n          case \"abs\": return Math.abs(this.asNumber(args[0]));\n          case \"floor\": return Math.floor(this.asNumber(args[0]));\n          case \"ceil\": return Math.ceil(this.asNumber(args[0]));\n          case \"round\": return Math.round(this.asNumber(args[0]));\n          case \"min\": return Math.min(this.asNumber(args[0]), this.asNumber(args[1]));\n          case \"max\": return Math.max(this.asNumber(args[0]), this.asNumber(args[1]));\n          case \"pow\": return Math.pow(this.asNumber(args[0]), this.asNumber(args[1]));\n          case \"radians\": return (this.asNumber(args[0]) * Math.PI) / 180.0;\n          case \"degrees\": return (this.asNumber(args[0]) * 180.0) / Math.PI;\n          case \"deg_to_rad\": return (this.asNumber(args[0]) * Math.PI) / 180.0;\n          case \"rgb\": {\n            if (args.length !== 3) throw new Error(\"rgb(r, g, b) needs 3 arguments\");\n            return new PvgColor(this.colorChannel(args[0]), this.colorChannel(args[1]), this.colorChannel(args[2]), 255);\n          }\n          case \"rgba\": {\n            if (args.length !== 4) throw new Error(\"rgba(r, g, b, a) needs 4 arguments\");\n            const av = this.asNumber(args[3]);\n            const ab = Number.isNaN(av) ? 0 : Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, av)) * 255);\n            return new PvgColor(this.colorChannel(args[0]), this.colorChannel(args[1]), this.colorChannel(args[2]), ab);\n          }\n          case \"noise2d\": {\n            if (args.length !== 2) throw new Error(\"noise2d(x, y) needs 2 arguments\");\n            return pvgNoise2(this.asNumber(args[0]), this.asNumber(args[1]));\n          }\n          case \"noise3d\": {\n            if (args.length !== 3) throw new Error(\"noise3d(x, y, z) needs 3 arguments\");\n            return pvgNoise3(this.asNumber(args[0]), this.asNumber(args[1]), this.asNumber(args[2]));\n          }\n          case \"array\":\n            return args;\n          case \"len\": {\n            if (args.length === 0) throw new Error(\"len(arr) needs 1 argument\");\n            const v = args[0];\n            if (isArrayValue(v)) return v.length;\n            if (typeof v === \"string\") return [...v].length;\n            throw new Error(\"len() expects an array or string\");\n          }\n          case \"get\": {\n            if (args.length !== 2) throw new Error(\"get(arr, i) needs 2 arguments\");\n            const idx = Math.trunc(this.asNumber(args[1]));\n            const target = args[0];\n            if (isArrayValue(target)) {\n              const n = target.length;\n              if (n === 0) throw new Error(\"get() from empty array\");\n              // Negative indices wrap (Python-style).\n              return target[(((idx % n) + n) % n) | 0];\n            }\n            throw new Error(\"get() expects an array\");\n          }\n          case \"random\": {\n            const min = this.asNumber(args[0]);\n            const max = this.asNumber(args[1]);\n            const r = this.nextRandom();\n            return min + r * (max - min);\n          }\n          default:\n            return this.invokeFunction(expr.name, args);\n        }\n      }\n      case \"Linear\": {\n        const s = this.asVec2(this.evalExpr(expr.start, locals));\n        const e = this.asVec2(this.evalExpr(expr.end, locals));\n        const trans = this.currentTransform();\n        const paint: Paint = {\n          kind: \"linear\",\n          start: trans.transformPoint(s),\n          end: trans.transformPoint(e),\n          stops: this.evalStops(expr.stops, locals),\n        };\n        return paint;\n      }\n      case \"Radial\": {\n        const c = this.asVec2(this.evalExpr(expr.center, locals));\n        const r = Math.max(0, this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(expr.radius, locals)));\n        const trans = this.currentTransform();\n        const f = expr.focal\n          ? trans.transformPoint(this.asVec2(this.evalExpr(expr.focal, locals)))\n          : null;\n        const paint: Paint = {\n          kind: \"radial\",\n          center: trans.transformPoint(c),\n          radius: r,\n          focal: f,\n          stops: this.evalStops(expr.stops, locals),\n        };\n        return paint;\n      }\n      case \"Angular\": {\n        const c = this.asVec2(this.evalExpr(expr.center, locals));\n        const sa = this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(expr.startAngle, locals));\n        const trans = this.currentTransform();\n        const paint: Paint = {\n          kind: \"angular\",\n          center: trans.transformPoint(c),\n          startAngle: sa,\n          stops: this.evalStops(expr.stops, locals),\n        };\n        return paint;\n      }\n      default:\n        throw new Error(`Unknown expression type '${(expr as Expr).type}'`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private evalStops(stops: GradientStopExpr[], locals: Map<string, Value>): GradientStop[] {\n    // Offsets clamped to [0,1]; colors incl. transparent alpha preserved (Section 9.4).\n    // Sorted by offset at evaluation (stable).\n    const out = (stops || []).map((s) => ({\n      offset: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(s.offset, locals)))),\n      color: this.asColor(this.evalExpr(s.color, locals)),\n    }));\n    out.sort((a, b) => a.offset - b.offset);\n    return out;\n  }\n\n  private asNumber(val: Value): number {\n    if (typeof val === \"number\") return val;\n    if (typeof val === \"boolean\") return val ? 1.0 : 0.0;\n    throw new Error(`Expected number, got ${JSON.stringify(val)}`);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Rounds a color channel to the nearest integer and clamps it to [0, 255]\n   * (Section 2.6 functional `rgb()` / `rgba()` form). Mirrors the Rust core's\n   * `color_channel` (round-then-clamp; NaN maps to 0 via an explicit guard,\n   * matching Rust's saturating float-to-int cast).\n   */\n  private colorChannel(val: Value): number {\n    const rounded = Math.round(this.asNumber(val));\n    if (Number.isNaN(rounded)) return 0;\n    return Math.max(0, Math.min(255, rounded));\n  }\n\n  private asString(val: Value): string {\n    return this.displayValue(val);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * String display conversion for `+` concatenation and text content.\n   * Mirrors Rust `Value::as_string`: strings pass through, numbers use integer\n   * formatting when integral and |n| < 1e15, bools print as `true`/`false`,\n   * arrays render recursively as `[a, b]`; colors, paints, vectors-as-values\n   * and `None` are runtime errors   TokenKind2["Angular"] = "Angular";
  TokenKind2["Stop"] = "Stop";
  TokenKind2["Start"] = "Start";
  TokenKind2["Quad"] = "Quad";
  TokenKind2["Curve"] = "Curve";
  TokenKind2["Arc"] = "Arc";
  TokenKind2["Close"] = "Close";
  TokenKind2["Snap"] = "Snap";
  TokenKind2["Filter"] = "Filter";
  TokenKind2["Param"] = "Param";
  TokenKind2["Pattern"] = "Pattern";
  TokenKind2["Sprite"] = "Sprite";
  TokenKind2["Spline"] = "Spline";
  TokenKind2["Palette"] = "Palette";
  TokenKind2["Data"] = "Data";
  TokenKind2["Row"] = "Row";
  TokenKind2["LBracket"] = "[";
  TokenKind2["RBracket"] = "]";
  TokenKind2["LParen"] = "(";
  TokenKind2["RParen"] = ")";
  TokenKind2["Comma"] = ",";
  TokenKind2["Question"] = "?";
  TokenKind2["Colon"] = ":";
  TokenKind2["Plus"] = "+";
  TokenKind2["Minus"] = "-";
  TokenKind2["Star"] = "*";
  TokenKind2["Slash"] = "/";
  TokenKind2["Percent"] = "%";
  TokenKind2["Caret"] = "^";
  TokenKind2["Equal"] = "=";
  TokenKind2["EqualEqual"] = "==";
  TokenKind2["NotEqual"] = "!=";
  TokenKind2["Less"] = "<";
  TokenKind2["LessEqual"] = "<=";
  TokenKind2["Greater"] = ">";
  TokenKind2["GreaterEqual"] = ">=";
  TokenKind2["And"] = "and";
  TokenKind2["Or"] = "or";
  TokenKind2["Not"] = "not";
  return TokenKind2;
})(TokenKind || {});
var Token = class {
  constructor(kind, value, line, col) {
    this.kind = kind;
    this.value = value;
    this.line = line;
    this.col = col;
  }
  kind;
  value;
  line;
  col;
};
function dedentCode(text) {
  if (!text) return "";
  const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/);
  while (lines.length > 0 && lines[0].trim().length === 0) {
    lines.shift();
  }
  while (lines.length > 0 && lines[lines.length - 1].trim().length === 0) {
    lines.pop();
  }
  if (lines.length === 0) return "";
  let minIndent = Infinity;
  for (const line of lines) {
    if (line.trim().length === 0) continue;
    const match = line.match(/^( +)/);
    const indent = match ? match[1].length : 0;
    if (indent < minIndent) {
      minIndent = indent;
    }
  }
  if (minIndent === Infinity || minIndent === 0) {
    return lines.join("\n");
  }
  return lines.map((line) => {
    if (line.trim().length === 0) return "";
    return line.startsWith(" ".repeat(minIndent)) ? line.slice(minIndent) : line.trimStart();
  }).join("\n");
}
var Lexer = class {
  source;
  lines;
  currentLineIdx = 0;
  indentStack = [0];
  constructor(source) {
    this.source = dedentCode(source);
    this.lines = this.source.split(/\r?\n/);
  }
  tokenizeAll() {
    const tokens = [];
    while (this.currentLineIdx < this.lines.length) {
      const rawLine = this.lines[this.currentLineIdx];
      const lineNum = this.currentLineIdx + 1;
      this.currentLineIdx++;
      const trimmed = rawLine.trimStart();
      if (trimmed.length === 0 || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
        continue;
      }
      if (rawLine.includes("	")) {
        throw new Error(`Line ${lineNum}: Tabs are forbidden. Use 2 spaces for indentation.`);
      }
      let spaces = 0;
      while (spaces < rawLine.length && rawLine[spaces] === " ") {
        spaces++;
      }
      const currentIndent = this.indentStack[this.indentStack.length - 1];
      if (spaces > currentIndent) {
        this.indentStack.push(spaces);
        tokens.push(new Token("Indent" /* Indent */, null, lineNum, spaces + 1));
      } else if (spaces < currentIndent) {
        while (this.indentStack.length > 0 && spaces < this.indentStack[this.indentStack.length - 1]) {
          this.indentStack.pop();
          tokens.push(new Token("Dedent" /* Dedent */, null, lineNum, spaces + 1));
        }
        if (spaces !== this.indentStack[this.indentStack.length - 1]) {
          throw new Error(`Line ${lineNum}: Inconsistent indentation level.`);
        }
      }
      const content = rawLine.slice(spaces);
      if (tripleOpenerBeforeComment(content)) {
        this.tokenizeLineWithTriple(content, lineNum, spaces + 1, spaces, tokens);
      } else {
        tokens.push(...this.tokenizeLine(content, lineNum, spaces + 1));
      }
      tokens.push(new Token("Newline" /* Newline */, null, lineNum, rawLine.length + 1));
    }
    while (this.indentStack.length > 1) {
      this.indentStack.pop();
      tokens.push(new Token("Dedent" /* Dedent */, null, this.lines.length || 1, 1));
    }
    tokens.push(new Token("Eof" /* Eof */, null, this.lines.length || 1, 1));
    return tokens;
  }
  /**
   * Lexes a line containing a `"""` opener. Emits the prefix tokens, one raw
   * multi-line `String` token, then consumes the continuation lines up to and
   * including the closing `"""` line (a trailing `# comment` is allowed on both
   * the opener and the closer line).
   */
  tokenizeLineWithTriple(content, lineNum, colOffset, baseSpaces, tokens) {
    const open = content.indexOf('"""');
    const prefix = content.slice(0, open);
    if (prefix.trim().length > 0) {
      tokens.push(...this.tokenizeLine(prefix, lineNum, colOffset));
    }
    const openCol = colOffset + open;
    const afterOpen = content.slice(open + 3);
    const close = afterOpen.indexOf('"""');
    if (close >= 0) {
      tokens.push(new Token("String" /* String */, afterOpen.slice(0, close), lineNum, openCol));
      const tail = afterOpen.slice(close + 3);
      if (tail.trim().length > 0) {
        tokens.push(...this.tokenizeLine(tail, lineNum, openCol + 3 + close + 3));
      }
      return;
    }
    const openTail = afterOpen.trimStart();
    if (!(openTail.length === 0 || openTail.startsWith("#"))) {
      throw new Error(
        `Line ${lineNum}, Col ${openCol}: Multi-line """ strings must start at the end of the line (e.g. \`data """\`).`
      );
    }
    const body = [];
    for (; ; ) {
      const nextIdx = this.currentLineIdx;
      if (nextIdx >= this.lines.length) {
        throw new Error(`Line ${lineNum}, Col ${openCol}: Unclosed triple-quoted string.`);
      }
      const raw = this.lines[nextIdx];
      this.currentLineIdx++;
      let sp = 0;
      while (sp < raw.length && raw[sp] === " ") sp++;
      if (raw.slice(sp).startsWith('"""')) {
        const closerTail = raw.slice(sp + 3).trimStart();
        if (!(closerTail.length === 0 || closerTail.startsWith("#"))) {
          throw new Error(
            `Line ${nextIdx + 1}, Col ${sp + 4}: Unexpected content after closing """.`
          );
        }
        break;
      }
      let cut = 0;
      while (cut < baseSpaces && cut < raw.length && raw[cut] === " ") cut++;
      body.push(raw.slice(cut));
    }
    tokens.push(new Token("String" /* String */, body.join("\n"), lineNum, openCol));
  }
  tokenizeLine(text, lineNum, colOffset) {
    const tokens = [];
    const len = text.length;
    let i = 0;
    while (i < len) {
      const c = text[i];
      if (c === " " || c === "	" || c === "\r") {
        i++;
        continue;
      }
      const col = colOffset + i;
      if (c === "#") {
        let hexEnd = i + 1;
        while (hexEnd < len && /[0-9a-fA-F]/.test(text[hexEnd])) {
          hexEnd++;
        }
        const hexLen = hexEnd - (i + 1);
        if (hexLen === 3 || hexLen === 6 || hexLen === 8) {
          const isDelim = hexEnd === len || /[\s\],):]/.test(text[hexEnd]);
          if (isDelim) {
            const hexStr = text.slice(i, hexEnd);
            const color = PvgColor.fromHex(hexStr);
            if (color) {
              tokens.push(new Token("Color" /* Color */, color, lineNum, col));
              i = hexEnd;
              continue;
            }
          }
        }
        break;
      }
      if (c === "[") {
        tokens.push(new Token("[" /* LBracket */, "[", lineNum, col));
        i++;
        continue;
      }
      if (c === "]") {
        tokens.push(new Token("]" /* RBracket */, "]", lineNum, col));
        i++;
        continue;
      }
      if (c === "(") {
        tokens.push(new Token("(" /* LParen */, "(", lineNum, col));
        i++;
        continue;
      }
      if (c === ")") {
        tokens.push(new Token(")" /* RParen */, ")", lineNum, col));
        i++;
        continue;
      }
      if (c === ",") {
        tokens.push(new Token("," /* Comma */, ",", lineNum, col));
        i++;
        continue;
      }
      if (c === "?") {
        tokens.push(new Token("?" /* Question */, "?", lineNum, col));
        i++;
        continue;
      }
      if (c === ":") {
        tokens.push(new Token(":" /* Colon */, ":", lineNum, col));
        i++;
        continue;
      }
      if (c === "^") {
        tokens.push(new Token("^" /* Caret */, "^", lineNum, col));
        i++;
        continue;
      }
      if (c === "=") {
        if (i + 1 < len && text[i + 1] === "=") {
          tokens.push(new Token("==" /* EqualEqual */, "==", lineNum, col));
          i += 2;
        } else {
          tokens.push(new Token("=" /* Equal */, "=", lineNum, col));
          i++;
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (c === "!") {
        if (i + 1 < len && text[i + 1] === "=") {
          tokens.push(new Token("!=" /* NotEqual */, "!=", lineNum, col));
          i += 2;
        } else {
          tokens.push(new Token("not" /* Not */, "not", lineNum, col));
          i++;
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (c === "<") {
        if (i + 1 < len && text[i + 1] === "=") {
          tokens.push(new Token("<=" /* LessEqual */, "<=", lineNum, col));
          i += 2;
        } else {
          tokens.push(new Token("<" /* Less */, "<", lineNum, col));
          i++;
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (c === ">") {
        if (i + 1 < len && text[i + 1] === "=") {
          tokens.push(new Token(">=" /* GreaterEqual */, ">=", lineNum, col));
          i += 2;
        } else {
          tokens.push(new Token(">" /* Greater */, ">", lineNum, col));
          i++;
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (c === "&" && i + 1 < len && text[i + 1] === "&") {
        tokens.push(new Token("and" /* And */, "and", lineNum, col));
        i += 2;
        continue;
      }
      if (c === "|" && i + 1 < len && text[i + 1] === "|") {
        tokens.push(new Token("or" /* Or */, "or", lineNum, col));
        i += 2;
        continue;
      }
      if (c === "+") {
        tokens.push(new Token("+" /* Plus */, "+", lineNum, col));
        i++;
        continue;
      }
      if (c === "-") {
        tokens.push(new Token("-" /* Minus */, "-", lineNum, col));
        i++;
        continue;
      }
      if (c === "*") {
        tokens.push(new Token("*" /* Star */, "*", lineNum, col));
        i++;
        continue;
      }
      if (c === "/") {
        tokens.push(new Token("/" /* Slash */, "/", lineNum, col));
        i++;
        continue;
      }
      if (c === "%") {
        tokens.push(new Token("%" /* Percent */, "%", lineNum, col));
        i++;
        continue;
      }
      if (c === '"') {
        i++;
        let strVal = "";
        let closed = false;
        while (i < len) {
          if (text[i] === "\\" && i + 1 < len) {
            const next = text[i + 1];
            if (next === "n") strVal += "\n";
            else if (next === "t") strVal += "	";
            else if (next === "r") strVal += "\r";
            else if (next === '"') strVal += '"';
            else if (next === "\\") strVal += "\\";
            else strVal += next;
            i += 2;
          } else if (text[i] === '"') {
            closed = true;
            i++;
            break;
          } else {
            strVal += text[i];
            i++;
          }
        }
        if (!closed) {
          throw new Error(`Line ${lineNum}: Unclosed string literal.`);
        }
        tokens.push(new Token("String" /* String */, strVal, lineNum, col));
        continue;
      }
      if (/[0-9]/.test(c) || c === "." && i + 1 < len && /[0-9]/.test(text[i + 1])) {
        const start = i;
        let hasDot = false;
        while (i < len && (/[0-9]/.test(text[i]) || !hasDot && text[i] === ".")) {
          if (text[i] === ".") hasDot = true;
          i++;
        }
        let numVal = parseFloat(text.slice(start, i));
        if (i + 3 <= len && text.slice(i, i + 3) === "deg") {
          numVal = numVal * Math.PI / 180;
          i += 3;
        } else if (i + 3 <= len && text.slice(i, i + 3) === "rad") {
          i += 3;
        }
        tokens.push(new Token("Number" /* Number */, numVal, lineNum, col));
        continue;
      }
      if (/[a-zA-Z_]/.test(c)) {
        const start = i;
        while (i < len && /[a-zA-Z0-9_-]/.test(text[i])) {
          i++;
        }
        const ident = text.slice(start, i);
        let kind = "Ident" /* Ident */;
        let value = ident;
        switch (ident) {
          case "PVG":
          case "CPSVG":
            kind = "Pvg" /* Pvg */;
            break;
          case "canvas":
            kind = "Canvas" /* Canvas */;
            break;
          case "background":
            kind = "Background" /* Background */;
            break;
          case "set":
            kind = "Set" /* Set */;
            break;
          case "def":
            kind = "Def" /* Def */;
            break;
          case "return":
            kind = "Return" /* Return */;
            break;
          case "for":
            kind = "For" /* For */;
            break;
          case "from":
            kind = "From" /* From */;
            break;
          case "to":
            kind = "To" /* To */;
            break;
          case "step":
            kind = "Step" /* Step */;
            break;
          case "while":
            kind = "While" /* While */;
            break;
          case "if":
            kind = "If" /* If */;
            break;
          case "else":
            kind = "Else" /* Else */;
            break;
          case "seed":
            kind = "Seed" /* Seed */;
            break;
          case "circle":
            kind = "Circle" /* Circle */;
            break;
          case "ellipse":
            kind = "Ellipse" /* Ellipse */;
            break;
          case "rectangle":
          case "rect":
            kind = "Rectangle" /* Rectangle */;
            break;
          case "line":
            kind = "Line" /* Line */;
            break;
          case "polygon":
            kind = "Polygon" /* Polygon */;
            break;
          case "path":
            kind = "Path" /* Path */;
            break;
          case "text":
            kind = "Text" /* Text */;
            break;
          case "group":
            kind = "Group" /* Group */;
            break;
          case "clip":
            kind = "Clip" /* Clip */;
            break;
          case "center":
            kind = "Center" /* Center */;
            break;
          case "radius":
            kind = "Radius" /* Radius */;
            break;
          case "pos":
            kind = "Pos" /* Pos */;
            break;
          case "size":
            kind = "Size" /* Size */;
            break;
          case "points":
            kind = "Points" /* Points */;
            break;
          case "content":
            kind = "Content" /* Content */;
            break;
          case "font":
            kind = "Font" /* Font */;
            break;
          case "align":
            kind = "Align" /* Align */;
            break;
          case "fill":
            kind = "Fill" /* Fill */;
            break;
          case "stroke":
            kind = "Stroke" /* Stroke */;
            break;
          case "width":
            kind = "Width" /* Width */;
            break;
          case "opacity":
            kind = "Opacity" /* Opacity */;
            break;
          case "rot":
            kind = "Rot" /* Rot */;
            break;
          case "scale":
            kind = "Scale" /* Scale */;

          case "start":

          case "quad":

            break;
          case "curve":
            kind = "Curve" /* Curve */;

          case "arc":

          case "close":

            break;
          // PVG 0.2 reserved keywords (Section 2.7)
          case "cap":

          case "linear":

          case "radial":
            kind = "Radial" /* Radial */;
            break;
          case "angular":

            kind = "Angular" /* Angular */;
            break;
          case "stop":
            kind = "Stop" /* Stop */;
            break;
          // Post-0.2 Section 18 keywords (soft: legal as identifiers where a name is expected)
          case "snap":
            kind = "Snap" /* Snap */;

          case "filter":
            kind = "Filter" /* Filter */;
            break;
          case "param":
            kind = "Param" /* Param */;
            break;
          case "pattern":
            kind = "Pattern" /* Pattern */;
            break;
          case "sprite":
            kind = "Sprite" /* Sprite */;
            break;
          case "spline":
            kind = "Spline" /* Spline */;
            break;
          case "palette":
            kind = "Palette" /* Palette */;
            break;
          case "data":
            kind = "Data" /* Data */;
            break;
          case "row":
            kind = "Row" /* Row */;
            break;
          case "and":
            kind = "and" /* And */;
            break;
          case "or":
            kind = "or" /* Or */;
            break;
          case "not":
            kind = "not" /* Not */;
            break;
          case "black":
            kind = "Color" /* Color */;
            value = PvgColor.Black();
            break;
          case "white":
            kind = "Color" /* Color */;
            value = PvgColor.White();
            break;
          case "red":
            kind = "Color" /* Color */;
            value = PvgColor.Red();
            break;
          case "green":
            kind = "Color" /* Color */;
            value = PvgColor.Green();
            break;
          case "blue":
            kind = "Color" /* Color */;
            value = PvgColor.Blue();
            break;
          case "yellow":
            kind = "Color" /* Color */;
            value = PvgColor.Yellow();

          case "cyan":

          case "none":
          case "transparent":
            kind = "Color" /* Color */;
            value = PvgColor.None();
            break;
        }
        tokens.push(new Token(kind, value, lineNum, col));
        continue;
      }
      throw new Error(`Line ${lineNum}, Col ${col}: Unexpected character '${c}'`);
    }
    return tokens;
  }
