function softIdentKind(kind, value) {
  switch (kind) {
    case "Ident" /* Ident */:
      return typeof value === "string" ? value : null;
    case "Row" /* Row */:
      return "row";
    case "Data" /* Data */:
      return "data";
    case "Filter" /* Filter */:
      return "filter";
    case "Snap" /* Snap */:
      return "snap";
    case "Palette" /* Palette */:
      return "palette";
    case "Param" /* Param */:
      return "param";
    case "Pattern" /* Pattern */:
      return "pattern";
    case "Sprite" /* Sprite */:
      return "sprite";
    case "Spline" /* Spline */:
      return "spline";
    default:
      return null;
  }
}
function tripleOpenerBeforeComment(content) {
  const open = content.indexOf('"""');
  if (open < 0) return false;
  let i = 0;
  while (i < open) {
    if (content[i] === "#") {
      let hexEnd = i + 1;
      while (hexEnd < content.length && /[0-9a-fA-F]/.test(content[hexEnd])) hexEnd++;
      const hexLen = hexEnd - (i + 1);
      if (hexLen === 3 || hexLen === 6 || hexLen === 8) {
        const isDelim = hexEnd === content.length || /\s/.test(content[hexEnd]) || ["]", ")", ",", ":", '"'].includes(content[hexEnd]);
        if (isDelim) {
          i = hexEnd;
          continue;
        }
      }
      return false;
    }
    i++;
  }
  return true;
}

// src/parser.ts
function emptyFx() {
  return {
    cap: null,
    join: null,
    miter: null,
    dash: null,
    align: null,
    blur: null,
    shadow: null,
    glow: null,
    blend: null
  };
}
var Parser = class {
  tokens;
  pos = 0;
  constructor(tokens) {
    this.tokens = tokens;
  }
  peek() {
    return this.tokens[Math.min(this.pos, this.tokens.length - 1)];
  }
  advance() {
    const tok = this.peek();
    if (this.pos < this.tokens.length) {
      this.pos++;
    }
    return tok;
  }
  match(kind) {
    if (this.peek().kind === kind) {
      this.advance();
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }
  expect(kind) {
    const tok = this.peek();
    if (tok.kind === kind) {
      return this.advance();
    }
    throw new Error(`Line ${tok.line}, Col ${tok.col}: Expected ${kind}, found ${tok.kind}`);
  }
  skipNewlines() {
    while (this.peek().kind === "Newline" /* Newline */) {
      this.advance();
    }
  }
  parseDocument() {
    this.skipNewlines();
    this.expect("Pvg" /* Pvg */);
    const verTok = this.advance();
    if (verTok.kind !== "Number" /* Number */ || typeof verTok.value !== "number") {
      throw new Error(`Line ${verTok.line}: Expected version number after PVG (e.g. 0.2)`);
    }
    const version = [
      Math.floor(verTok.value),
      Math.round(verTok.value % 1 * 10)
    ];
    this.skipNewlines();
    this.expect("Canvas" /* Canvas */);
    const wTok = this.advance();
    const hTok = this.advance();
    if (wTok.kind !== "Number" /* Number */ || hTok.kind !== "Number" /* Number */ || typeof wTok.value !== "number" || typeof hTok.value !== "number") {
      throw new Error(`Line ${wTok.line}: Expected canvas width and height numbers`);
    }
    const width = wTok.value;
    const height = hTok.value;
    let background = null;
    let snap = 0;
    let pixelFilter = "linear";
    if (this.match("Newline" /* Newline */) && this.match("Indent" /* Indent */)) {
      while (this.peek().kind !== "Dedent" /* Dedent */ && this.peek().kind !== "Eof" /* Eof */) {
        if (this.peek().kind === "Newline" /* Newline */) {
          this.advance();
          continue;
        }
        if (this.match("Background" /* Background */)) {
          const bgTok = this.advance();
          if (bgTok.kind === "Color" /* Color */ && bgTok.value instanceof PvgColor) {
            background = bgTok.value;
          } else {
            throw new Error(`Line ${bgTok.line}: Expected color for canvas background`);
          }
        } else if (this.match("Snap" /* Snap */)) {
          const sTok = this.advance();
          if (sTok.kind !== "Number" /* Number */ || typeof sTok.value !== "number") {
            throw new Error(`Line ${sTok.line}: Expected number for canvas snap grid`);
          }
          snap = Math.max(0, sTok.value);
        } else if (this.match("Filter" /* Filter */)) {
          const fTok = this.advance();
          const name = typeof fTok.value === "string" ? fTok.value.toLowerCase() : "";
          pixelFilter = name === "nearest" ? "nearest" : "linear";
        } else {
          throw new Error(`Line ${this.peek().line}: Invalid canvas property '${this.peek().kind}'`);
        }
        this.skipNewlines();
      }
      this.match("Dedent" /* Dedent */);
    }
    this.skipNewlines();
    const params = [];
    const patterns = [];
    const statements = [];
    while (this.peek().kind !== "Eof" /* Eof */) {
      if (this.peek().kind === "Newline" /* Newline */) {
        this.advance();
        continue;
      }
      if (this.peek().kind === "Param" /* Param */) {
        params.push(this.parseParamDecl());
        this.skipNewlines();
        continue;
      }
      if (this.peek().kind === "Pattern" /* Pattern */) {
        patterns.push(this.parsePatternDef());
        this.skipNewlines();
        continue;
      }
      statements.push(this.parseStatement());
      this.skipNewlines();
    }
    return {
      version,
      canvas: { width, height, background, snap, pixelFilter },
      params,
      patterns,
      statements
    };
  }
  /** `param <name> : <expr>` or `param <name> = <expr>` (Section 18.1). */
  parseParamDecl() {
    this.expect("Param" /* Param */);
    const nameTok = this.advance();
    const name = softIdentKind(nameTok.kind, nameTok.value);
    if (name === null) {
      throw new Error(`Line ${nameTok.line}: Expected param name, found '${nameTok.kind}'`);
    }
    if (!(this.match(":" /* Colon */) || this.match("=" /* Equal */))) {
      throw new Error(`Line ${this.peek().line}: Expected ':' or '=' after param name (e.g. \`param health: 0.75\`)`);
    }
    const def = this.parseExpression();
    return { name, default: def };
  }
  /** `pattern <name> <w> <h>` + indented body block (Section 18.4). */
  parsePatternDef() {
    this.expect("Pattern" /* Pattern */);
    const nameTok = this.advance();
    const name = softIdentKind(nameTok.kind, nameTok.value);
    if (name === null) {
      throw new Error(`Line ${nameTok.line}: Expected pattern name, found '${nameTok.kind}'`);
    }
    const wTok = this.advance();
    const hTok = this.advance();
    if (wTok.kind !== "Number" /* Number */ || hTok.kind !== "Number" /* Number */ || typeof wTok.value !== "number" || typeof hTok.value !== "number") {
      throw new Error(`Line ${wTok.line}: Expected pattern tile width and height numbers`);
    }
    this.skipNewlines();
    const body = this.parseBlock();
    return { name, width: wTok.value, height: hTok.value, body };
  }
  parseStatement() {
    const tok = this.peek();
    switch (tok.kind) {
      case "Set" /* Set */: {
        this.advance();
        const nameTok = this.advance();
        const name = softIdentKind(nameTok.kind, nameTok.value);
        if (name === null) {
          throw new Error(`Line ${tok.line}: Expected identifier name after 'set'`);
        }
        this.expect("=" /* Equal */);
        const expr = this.parseExpression();
        return { type: "Set", name, expr };
      }
      case "Seed" /* Seed */: {
        this.advance();
        const seedTok = this.advance();
        return {
          type: "Seed",
          // Non-numeric seeds fall back to 0 (= engine default seed), mirroring
          // the Rust core (`Number(n) => n as u64, _ => 0`).
          seed: seedTok.kind === "Number" /* Number */ && typeof seedTok.value === "number" ? Math.floor(seedTok.value) : 0
        };
      }
      case "Def" /* Def */: {
        this.advance();
        const nameTok = this.advance();
        const fnName = softIdentKind(nameTok.kind, nameTok.value);
        if (fnName === null) {
          throw new Error(`Line ${tok.line}: Expected function name`);
        }
        this.expect("(" /* LParen */);
        const params = [];
        if (this.peek().kind !== ")" /* RParen */) {
          while (true) {
            const pTok = this.advance();
            const pName = softIdentKind(pTok.kind, pTok.value);
            if (pName !== null) {
              params.push(pName);
            }
            if (this.peek().kind === "," /* Comma */) {
              this.advance();
            } else {
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        this.expect(")" /* RParen */);
        this.skipNewlines();
        const body = this.parseBlock();
        return { type: "Def", name: fnName, params, body };
      }
      case "For" /* For */: {
        this.advance();
        const varTok = this.advance();
        const varName = softIdentKind(varTok.kind, varTok.value);
        if (varName === null) {
          throw new Error(`Line ${tok.line}: Expected loop variable`);
        }
        this.expect("From" /* From */);
        const from = this.parseExpression();
        this.expect("To" /* To */);
        const to = this.parseExpression();
        let step = null;
        if (this.match("Step" /* Step */)) {
          step = this.parseExpression();
        }
        this.skipNewlines();
        const body = this.parseBlock();
        return { type: "For", var: varName, from, to, step, body };
      }
      case "While" /* While */: {
        this.advance();
        const cond = this.parseExpression();
        this.skipNewlines();
        const body = this.parseBlock();
        return { type: "While", cond, body };
      }
      case "If" /* If */: {
        this.advance();
        const cond = this.parseExpression();
        this.skipNewlines();
        const thenBody = this.parseBlock();
        let elseBody = [];
        this.skipNewlines();
        if (this.match("Else" /* Else */)) {
          if (this.peek().kind === "If" /* If */) {
            elseBody.push(this.parseStatement());
          } else {
            this.skipNewlines();
            elseBody = this.parseBlock();
          }
        }
        return { type: "If", cond, thenBody, elseBody };
      }
      case "Return" /* Return */: {
        this.advance();
        const expr = this.parseExpression();
        return { type: "Return", expr };
      }
      case "Circle" /* Circle */:
        this.advance();
        this.skipNewlines();
        return this.parseCircle();
      case "Ellipse" /* Ellipse */:
        this.advance();
        this.skipNewlines();
        return this.parseEllipse();
      case "Rectangle" /* Rectangle */:
        this.advance();
        this.skipNewlines();
        return this.parseRectangle();
      case "Line" /* Line */:
        this.advance();
        this.skipNewlines();
        return this.parseLine();
      case "Polygon" /* Polygon */:
        this.advance();
        this.skipNewlines();
        return this.parsePolygon();
      case "Path" /* Path */:
        this.advance();
        this.skipNewlines();
        return this.parsePath();
      case "Text" /* Text */:
        this.advance();
        this.skipNewlines();
        return this.parseText();
      case "Group" /* Group */:
        this.advance();
        this.skipNewlines();
        return this.parseGroup();
      case "Clip" /* Clip */:
        this.advance();
        this.skipNewlines();
        return this.parseClip();
      case "Sprite" /* Sprite */:
        this.advance();
        this.skipNewlines();
        return this.parseSprite();
      case "Spline" /* Spline */:
        this.advance();
        this.skipNewlines();
        return this.parseSpline();
      case "Param" /* Param */: {
        const decl = this.parseParamDecl();
        return { type: "Set", name: decl.name, expr: decl.default };
      }
      default: {
        if (tok.kind === "Pattern" /* Pattern */) {
          throw new Error(`Line ${tok.line}: Pattern blocks must be declared at top level.`);
        }
        const softName = softIdentKind(tok.kind, tok.value);
        if (softName !== null && this.tokens[this.pos + 1]?.kind === "(" /* LParen */) {
          this.advance();
          this.expect("(" /* LParen */);
          const args = [];
          if (this.peek().kind !== ")" /* RParen */) {
            while (true) {
              args.push(this.parseExpression());
              if (this.peek().kind === "," /* Comma */) {
                this.advance();
              } else {
                break;
              }
            }
          }
          this.expect(")" /* RParen */);
          return { type: "Call", name: softName, args };
        }
        throw new Error(`Line ${tok.line}: Unexpected statement token '${tok.kind}'`);
      }
    }
  }
  parseBlock() {
    this.expect("Indent" /* Indent */);
    const statements = [];
    while (this.peek().kind !== "Dedent" /* Dedent */ && this.peek().kind !== "Eof" /* Eof */) {
      if (this.peek().kind === "Newline" /* Newline */) {
        this.advance();
        continue;
      }
      statements.push(this.parseStatement());
      this.skipNewlines();
    }
    this.expect("Dedent" /* Dedent */);
    return statements;
  }
  // ---- PVG 0.2 paint & FX helpers (mirror Rust parse_paint_expr) ----
  parsePaintExpr() {
    if (this.peek().kind === "Linear" /* Linear */) {
      this.advance();
      const start = this.parseExpression();
      const end = this.parseExpression();
      const stops = this.tryParseGradientStops();
      return { type: "Linear", start, end, stops };
    }
    if (this.peek().kind === "Radial" /* Radial */) {
      this.advance();
      const center = this.parseExpression();
      const radius = this.parseExpression();
      let focal = null;
      if (this.peek().kind === "[" /* LBracket */) {
        focal = this.parseExpression();
      }
      const stops = this.tryParseGradientStops();
      return { type: "Radial", center, radius, focal, stops };
    }
    if (this.peek().kind === "Angular" /* Angular */) {
      this.advance();
      const center = this.parseExpression();
      const startAngle = this.parseExpression();
      const stops = this.tryParseGradientStops();
      return { type: "Angular", center, startAngle, stops };
    }
    if (this.peek().kind === "Pattern" /* Pattern */) {
      const after = this.tokens[this.pos + 1];
      const refName = after ? softIdentKind(after.kind, after.value) : null;
      if (refName !== null) {
        this.advance();
        this.advance();
        return { type: "Pattern", name: refName };
      }
    }
    return this.parseExpression();
  }
  tryParseGradientStops() {
    if (this.peek().kind !== "Newline" /* Newline */) return [];
    let j = this.pos + 1;
    while (j < this.tokens.length && this.tokens[j].kind === "Newline" /* Newline */) j++;
    if (j >= this.tokens.length || this.tokens[j].kind !== "Indent" /* Indent */) return [];
    j++;
    while (j < this.tokens.length && this.tokens[j].kind === "Newline" /* Newline */) j++;
    if (j >= this.tokens.length || this.tokens[j].kind !== "Stop" /* Stop */) return [];
    while (this.peek().kind === "Newline" /* Newline */) this.advance();
    this.expect("Indent" /* Indent */);
    const stops = [];
    for (; ; ) {
      this.skipNewlines();
      if (this.peek().kind === "Dedent" /* Dedent */) {
        this.advance();
        break;
      }
      if (this.peek().kind === "Eof" /* Eof */) break;
      this.expect("Stop" /* Stop */);
      const offset = this.parseExpression();
      const color = this.parseExpression();
      stops.push({ type: "GradientStop", offset, color });
      this.skipNewlines();
    }
    return stops;
  }
  parseDashArray() {
    this.expect("[" /* LBracket */);
    const items = [];
    this.skipNewlines();
    if (this.peek().kind !== "]" /* RBracket */) {
      for (; ; ) {
        items.push(this.parseExpression());
        if (this.peek().kind === "," /* Comma */) {
          this.advance();
          this.skipNewlines();
        } else break;
      }
    }
    this.expect("]" /* RBracket */);
    return items;
  }
  parseShadowExpr() {
    const offset = this.parseExpression();
    const radius = this.parseExpression();
    const color = this.parseExpression();
    return { type: "ShadowExpr", offset, radius, color };
  }
  parseGlowExpr() {
    const radius = this.parseExpression();
    const color = this.parseExpression();
    return { type: "GlowExpr", radius, color };
  }
  // Consumes one 0.2 style prop if the cursor is on it; returns true when handled.
  parseStylePropInto(out) {
    switch (this.peek().kind) {
      case "Cap" /* Cap */:
        this.advance();
        out.cap = this.parseExpression();
        return true;
      case "Join" /* Join */:
        this.advance();
        out.join = this.parseExpression();
        return true;
      case "Miter" /* Miter */:
        this.advance();
        out.miter = this.parseExpression();
        return true;
      case "Dash" /* Dash */:
        this.advance();
        out.dash = this.parseDashArray();
        return true;
      case "Align" /* Align */:
        this.advance();
        out.align = this.parseExpression();
        return true;
      case "Blur" /* Blur */:
        this.advance();
        out.blur = this.parseExpression();
        return true;
      case "Shadow" /* Shadow */:
        this.advance();
        out.shadow = this.parseShadowExpr();
        return true;
      case "Glow" /* Glow */:
        this.advance();
        out.glow = this.parseGlowExpr();
        return true;
      case "Blend" /* Blend */:
        this.advance();
        out.blend = this.parseExpression();
        return true;
      default:
        return false;
    }
  }
  parseCircle() {
    this.expect("Indent" /* Indent */);
    let center = null, radius = null, fill = null, stroke = null, width = null, opacity = null;
    const fx = emptyFx();
    while (this.peek().kind !== "Dedent" /* Dedent */ && this.peek().kind !== "Eof" /* Eof */) {
      switch (this.peek().kind) {
        case "Center" /* Center */:
          this.advance();
          center = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Radius" /* Radius */:
          this.advance();
          radius = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Fill" /* Fill */:
          this.advance();
          fill = this.parsePaintExpr();
          break;
        case "Stroke" /* Stroke */:
          this.advance();
          stroke = this.parsePaintExpr();
          break;
        case "Width" /* Width */:
          this.advance();
          width = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Opacity" /* Opacity */:
          this.advance();
          opacity = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Newline" /* Newline */:
          this.advance();
          break;
        default:
          if (this.parseStylePropInto(fx)) break;
          throw new Error(`Line ${this.peek().line}: Invalid circle property '${this.peek().kind}'`);
      }
      this.skipNewlines();
    }
    this.expect("Dedent" /* Dedent */);
    if (!center || !radius) throw new Error("Circle requires 'center [x, y]' and 'radius r'");
    return { type: "Circle", center, radius, fill, stroke, width, opacity, ...fx };
  }
  parseEllipse() {
    this.expect("Indent" /* Indent */);
    let center = null, radius = null, fill = null, stroke = null, width = null, opacity = null;
    const fx = emptyFx();
    while (this.peek().kind !== "Dedent" /* Dedent */ && this.peek().kind !== "Eof" /* Eof */) {
      switch (this.peek().kind) {
        case "Center" /* Center */:
          this.advance();
          center = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Radius" /* Radius */:
          this.advance();
          radius = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Fill" /* Fill */:
          this.advance();
          fill = this.parsePaintExpr();
          break;
        case "Stroke" /* Stroke */:
          this.advance();
          stroke = this.parsePaintExpr();
          break;
        case "Width" /* Width */:
          this.advance();
          width = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Opacity" /* Opacity */:
          this.advance();
          opacity = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Newline" /* Newline */:
          this.advance();
          break;
        default:
          if (this.parseStylePropInto(fx)) break;
          throw new Error(`Line ${this.peek().line}: Invalid ellipse property '${this.peek().kind}'`);
      }
      this.skipNewlines();
    }
    this.expect("Dedent" /* Dedent */);
    if (!center || !radius) throw new Error("Ellipse requires 'center [x, y]' and 'radius [rx, ry]'");
    return { type: "Ellipse", center, radius, fill, stroke, width, opacity, ...fx };
  }
  parseRectangle() {
    this.expect("Indent" /* Indent */);
    let pos = null, size = null, radius = null, fill = null, stroke = null, width = null, opacity = null;
    const fx = emptyFx();
    while (this.peek().kind !== "Dedent" /* Dedent */ && this.peek().kind !== "Eof" /* Eof */) {
      switch (this.peek().kind) {
        case "Pos" /* Pos */:
          this.advance();
          pos = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Size" /* Size */:
          this.advance();
          size = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Radius" /* Radius */:
          this.advance();
          radius = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Fill" /* Fill */:
          this.advance();
          fill = this.parsePaintExpr();
          break;
        case "Stroke" /* Stroke */:
          this.advance();
          stroke = this.parsePaintExpr();
          break;
        case "Width" /* Width */:
          this.advance();
          width = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Opacity" /* Opacity */:
          this.advance();
          opacity = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Newline" /* Newline */:
          this.advance();
          break;
        default:
          if (this.parseStylePropInto(fx)) break;
          throw new Error(`Line ${this.peek().line}: Invalid rectangle property '${this.peek().kind}'`);
      }
      this.skipNewlines();
    }
    this.expect("Dedent" /* Dedent */);
    if (!pos || !size) throw new Error("Rectangle requires 'pos [x, y]' and 'size [w, h]'");
    return { type: "Rectangle", pos, size, radius, fill, stroke, width, opacity, ...fx };
  }
  parseLine() {
    this.expect("Indent" /* Indent */);
    let from = null, to = null, stroke = null, width = null, opacity = null;
    const fx = emptyFx();
    while (this.peek().kind !== "Dedent" /* Dedent */ && this.peek().kind !== "Eof" /* Eof */) {
      switch (this.peek().kind) {
        case "From" /* From */:
          this.advance();
          from = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "To" /* To */:
          this.advance();
          to = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Stroke" /* Stroke */:
          this.advance();
          stroke = this.parsePaintExpr();
          break;
        case "Width" /* Width */:
          this.advance();
          width = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Opacity" /* Opacity */:
          this.advance();
          opacity = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Newline" /* Newline */:
          this.advance();
          break;
        default:
          if (this.parseStylePropInto(fx)) break;
          throw new Error(`Line ${this.peek().line}: Invalid line property '${this.peek().kind}'`);
      }
      this.skipNewlines();
    }
    this.expect("Dedent" /* Dedent */);
    if (!from || !to) throw new Error("Line requires 'from [x, y]' and 'to [x, y]'");
    return { type: "Line", from, to, stroke, width, opacity, ...fx };
  }
  parsePolygon() {
    this.expect("Indent" /* Indent */);
    const points = [];
    let fill = null, stroke = null, width = null, opacity = null;
    const fx = emptyFx();
    while (this.peek().kind !== "Dedent" /* Dedent */ && this.peek().kind !== "Eof" /* Eof */) {
      switch (this.peek().kind) {
        case "Points" /* Points */:
          this.advance();
          while (this.peek().kind === "[" /* LBracket */) {
            points.push(this.parseExpression());
          }
          break;
        case "Fill" /* Fill */:
          this.advance();
          fill = this.parsePaintExpr();
          break;
        case "Stroke" /* Stroke */:
          this.advance();
          stroke = this.parsePaintExpr();
          break;
        case "Width" /* Width */:
          this.advance();
          width = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Opacity" /* Opacity */:
          this.advance();
          opacity = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Newline" /* Newline */:
          this.advance();
          break;
        default:
          if (this.parseStylePropInto(fx)) break;
          throw new Error(`Line ${this.peek().line}: Invalid polygon property '${this.peek().kind}'`);
      }
      this.skipNewlines();
    }
    this.expect("Dedent" /* Dedent */);
    return { type: "Polygon", points, fill, stroke, width, opacity, ...fx };
  }
  parsePath() {
    this.expect("Indent" /* Indent */);
    let fill = null, stroke = null, width = null, opacity = null;
    const fx = emptyFx();
    const commands = [];
    while (this.peek().kind !== "Dedent" /* Dedent */ && this.peek().kind !== "Eof" /* Eof */) {
      switch (this.peek().kind) {
        case "Set" /* Set */: {
          this.advance();
          const nameTok = this.advance();
          const name = softIdentKind(nameTok.kind, nameTok.value);
          if (name === null) {
            throw new Error(`Line ${nameTok.line}: Expected identifier name after 'set'`);
          }
          this.expect("=" /* Equal */);
          const expr = this.parseExpression();
          commands.push({ cmd: "Set", name, expr });
          break;
        }
        // Post-0.2 Section 18.6: control flow inside a path body shares the path locals
        // and emits path commands (style props stay in the outer body).
        case "For" /* For */: {
          this.advance();
          const varTok = this.advance();
          const varName = softIdentKind(varTok.kind, varTok.value);
          if (varName === null) {
            throw new Error(`Line ${varTok.line}: Expected loop variable`);
          }
          this.expect("From" /* From */);
          const from = this.parseExpression();
          this.expect("To" /* To */);
          const to = this.parseExpression();
          let step = null;
          if (this.match("Step" /* Step */)) {
            step = this.parseExpression();
          }
          this.skipNewlines();
          const body = this.parsePathBlock();
          commands.push({ cmd: "For", varName, from, to, step, body });
          break;
        }
        case "While" /* While */: {
          this.advance();
          const cond = this.parseExpression();
          this.skipNewlines();
          const body = this.parsePathBlock();
          commands.push({ cmd: "While", cond, body });
          break;
        }
        case "If" /* If */: {
          commands.push(this.parsePathIf());
          break;
        }
        case "Fill" /* Fill */:
          this.advance();
          fill = this.parsePaintExpr();
          break;
        case "Stroke" /* Stroke */:
          this.advance();
          stroke = this.parsePaintExpr();
          break;
        case "Width" /* Width */:
          this.advance();
          width = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Opacity" /* Opacity */:
          this.advance();
          opacity = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Start" /* Start */:
          this.advance();
          commands.push({ cmd: "Start", pt: this.parseExpression() });
          break;
        case "Line" /* Line */:
          this.advance();
          commands.push({ cmd: "Line", pt: this.parseExpression() });
          break;
        case "Quad" /* Quad */: {
          this.advance();
          const cp = this.parseExpression();
          const ep = this.parseExpression();
          commands.push({ cmd: "Quad", cp, ep });
          break;
        }
        case "Curve" /* Curve */: {
          this.advance();
          const c1 = this.parseExpression();
          const c2 = this.parseExpression();
          const ep = this.parseExpression();
          commands.push({ cmd: "Curve", c1, c2, ep });
          break;
        }
        case "Arc" /* Arc */: {
          this.advance();
          const center = this.parseExpression();
          const radius = this.parseExpression();
          const startAngle = this.parseExpression();
          const endAngle = this.parseExpression();
          commands.push({ cmd: "Arc", center, radius, startAngle, endAngle });
          break;
        }
        case "Close" /* Close */:
          this.advance();
          commands.push({ cmd: "Close" });
          break;
        case "Newline" /* Newline */:
          this.advance();
          break;
        default:
          if (this.parseStylePropInto(fx)) break;
          throw new Error(`Line ${this.peek().line}: Invalid path property/command '${this.peek().kind}'`);
      }
      this.skipNewlines();
    }
    this.expect("Dedent" /* Dedent */);
    return { type: "Path", fill, stroke, width, opacity, commands, ...fx };
  }
  /**
   * Post-0.2 Section 18.6: a `path` sub-block. Accepts only path commands, `set` and
   * nested control flow — style properties are rejected inside a control block
   * (they belong to the outer path body), mirroring the Rust parser.
   */
  parsePathBlock() {
    this.expect("Indent" /* Indent */);
    const commands = [];
    while (this.peek().kind !== "Dedent" /* Dedent */ && this.peek().kind !== "Eof" /* Eof */) {
      if (this.peek().kind === "Newline" /* Newline */) {
        this.advance();
        continue;
      }
      commands.push(this.parsePathItem());
      this.skipNewlines();
    }
    this.expect("Dedent" /* Dedent */);
    return commands;
  }
  /** Parses one path-body item (command, `set`, or control flow). */
  parsePathItem() {
    const tok = this.peek();
    switch (tok.kind) {
      case "Set" /* Set */: {
        this.advance();
        const nameTok = this.advance();
        const name = softIdentKind(nameTok.kind, nameTok.value);
        if (name === null) {
          throw new Error(`Line ${nameTok.line}: Expected identifier name after 'set'`);
        }
        this.expect("=" /* Equal */);
        return { cmd: "Set", name, expr: this.parseExpression() };
      }
      case "Start" /* Start */:
        this.advance();
        return { cmd: "Start", pt: this.parseExpression() };
      case "Line" /* Line */:
        this.advance();
        return { cmd: "Line", pt: this.parseExpression() };
      case "Quad" /* Quad */: {
        this.advance();
        const cp = this.parseExpression();
        const ep = this.parseExpression();
        return { cmd: "Quad", cp, ep };
      }
      case "Curve" /* Curve */: {
        this.advance();
        const c1 = this.parseExpression();
        const c2 = this.parseExpression();
        const ep = this.parseExpression();
        return { cmd: "Curve", c1, c2, ep };
      }
      case "Arc" /* Arc */: {
        this.advance();
        const center = this.parseExpression();
        const radius = this.parseExpression();
        const startAngle = this.parseExpression();
        const endAngle = this.parseExpression();
        return { cmd: "Arc", center, radius, startAngle, endAngle };
      }
      case "Close" /* Close */:
        this.advance();
        return { cmd: "Close" };
      case "For" /* For */: {
        this.advance();
        const varTok = this.advance();
        const varName = softIdentKind(varTok.kind, varTok.value);
        if (varName === null) {
          throw new Error(`Line ${varTok.line}: Expected loop variable`);
        }
        this.expect("From" /* From */);
        const from = this.parseExpression();
        this.expect("To" /* To */);
        const to = this.parseExpression();
        let step = null;
        if (this.match("Step" /* Step */)) {
          step = this.parseExpression();
        }
        this.skipNewlines();
        return { cmd: "For", varName, from, to, step, body: this.parsePathBlock() };
      }
      case "While" /* While */: {
        this.advance();
        const cond = this.parseExpression();
        this.skipNewlines();
        return { cmd: "While", cond, body: this.parsePathBlock() };
      }
      case "If" /* If */:
        return this.parsePathIf();
      default:
        throw new Error(
          `Line ${tok.line}: Invalid path command '${tok.kind}' (style properties belong in the outer path body)`
        );
    }
  }
  /** `if <cond>` / `else` (including `else if`) inside a `path` body. */
  parsePathIf() {
    this.expect("If" /* If */);
    const cond = this.parseExpression();
    this.skipNewlines();
    const thenBody = this.parsePathBlock();
    let elseBody = [];
    this.skipNewlines();
    if (this.match("Else" /* Else */)) {
      if (this.peek().kind === "If" /* If */) {
        elseBody = [this.parsePathIf()];
      } else {
        this.skipNewlines();
        elseBody = this.parsePathBlock();
      }
    }
    return { cmd: "If", cond, thenBody, elseBody };
  }
  /** `palette [c0, c1, ...]` (Section 18.3). */
  parsePaletteArray() {
    this.expect("[" /* LBracket */);
    const items = [];
    this.skipNewlines();
    if (this.peek().kind !== "]" /* RBracket */) {
      for (; ; ) {
        items.push(this.parseExpression());
        if (this.peek().kind === "," /* Comma */) {
          this.advance();
          this.skipNewlines();
        } else break;
      }
    }
    this.expect("]" /* RBracket */);
    return items;
  }
  /** Section 18.3 pixel-art sprite: `pos`, `palette`, repeatable `data`/`row` strings. */
  parseSprite() {
    this.expect("Indent" /* Indent */);
    let pos = null;
    let palette = [];
    const rows = [];
    let scale = null;
    let opacity = null;
    let blend = null;
    while (this.peek().kind !== "Dedent" /* Dedent */ && this.peek().kind !== "Eof" /* Eof */) {
      switch (this.peek().kind) {
        case "Pos" /* Pos */:
          this.advance();
          pos = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Palette" /* Palette */:
          this.advance();
          palette = this.parsePaletteArray();
          break;
        case "Data" /* Data */:
        case "Row" /* Row */: {
          this.advance();
          const strTok = this.advance();
          if (strTok.kind !== "String" /* String */ || typeof strTok.value !== "string") {
            throw new Error(
              `Line ${strTok.line}: Expected quoted pixel row after \`data\` (e.g. data "..11.." or a """ block).`
            );
          }
          let kept = 0;
          for (const rawRow of strTok.value.split("\n")) {
            const row = rawRow.endsWith("\r") ? rawRow.slice(0, -1) : rawRow;
            if (row.trim().length === 0) continue;
            rows.push(row);
            kept++;
          }
          if (kept === 0) {
            throw new Error(`Line ${strTok.line}: Sprite \`data\` block has no pixel rows.`);
          }
          break;
        }
        case "Scale" /* Scale */:
          this.advance();
          scale = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Opacity" /* Opacity */:
          this.advance();
          opacity = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Blend" /* Blend */:
          this.advance();
          blend = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Newline" /* Newline */:
          this.advance();
          break;
        default:
          throw new Error(`Line ${this.peek().line}: Invalid sprite property '${this.peek().kind}'`);
      }
      this.skipNewlines();
    }
    this.expect("Dedent" /* Dedent */);
    if (!pos) throw new Error("Sprite requires 'pos [x, y]'");
    if (palette.length === 0) throw new Error("Sprite requires 'palette [c0, c1, ...]'.");
    if (rows.length === 0) throw new Error('Sprite requires at least one `data "..."` row.');
    return { type: "Sprite", pos, palette, rows, scale, opacity, blend };
  }
  /** Section 18.5 Catmull-Rom data spline (stroke-only; no `fill`, no `align`). */
  parseSpline() {
    this.expect("Indent" /* Indent */);
    let points = null;
    let pos = null;
    let size = null;
    let stroke = null;
    let width = null;
    let opacity = null;
    const fx = emptyFx();
    while (this.peek().kind !== "Dedent" /* Dedent */ && this.peek().kind !== "Eof" /* Eof */) {
      switch (this.peek().kind) {
        case "Points" /* Points */:
          this.advance();
          points = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Pos" /* Pos */:
          this.advance();
          pos = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Size" /* Size */:
          this.advance();
          size = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Stroke" /* Stroke */:
          this.advance();
          stroke = this.parsePaintExpr();
          break;
        case "Width" /* Width */:
          this.advance();
          width = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Opacity" /* Opacity */:
          this.advance();
          opacity = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Newline" /* Newline */:
          this.advance();
          break;
        default:
          if (this.peek().kind !== "Align" /* Align */ && this.parseStylePropInto(fx)) break;
          throw new Error(`Line ${this.peek().line}: Invalid spline property '${this.peek().kind}'`);
      }
      this.skipNewlines();
    }
    this.expect("Dedent" /* Dedent */);
    if (!points) throw new Error("Spline requires 'points <array>'");
    return {
      type: "Spline",
      points,
      pos,
      size,
      stroke,
      width,
      opacity,
      cap: fx.cap,
      join: fx.join,
      miter: fx.miter,
      dash: fx.dash,
      blur: fx.blur,
      shadow: fx.shadow,
      glow: fx.glow,
      blend: fx.blend
    };
  }
  parseText() {
    this.expect("Indent" /* Indent */);
    let pos = null, content = null, size = null, font = null, align = null, fill = null, stroke = null, width = null, opacity = null;
    let blur = null, shadow = null, glow = null, blend = null;
    while (this.peek().kind !== "Dedent" /* Dedent */ && this.peek().kind !== "Eof" /* Eof */) {
      switch (this.peek().kind) {
        case "Pos" /* Pos */:
          this.advance();
          pos = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Content" /* Content */:
        case "Text" /* Text */:
          this.advance();
          content = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Size" /* Size */:
          this.advance();
          size = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Font" /* Font */:
          this.advance();
          font = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Align" /* Align */:
          this.advance();
          align = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Fill" /* Fill */:
          this.advance();
          fill = this.parsePaintExpr();
          break;
        case "Stroke" /* Stroke */:
          this.advance();
          stroke = this.parsePaintExpr();
          break;
        case "Width" /* Width */:
          this.advance();
          width = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Opacity" /* Opacity */:
          this.advance();
          opacity = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        // NOTE: text keeps 0.1-compatible align (anchor); cap/join/miter/dash rejected per spec.
        case "Blur" /* Blur */:
          this.advance();
          blur = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Shadow" /* Shadow */:
          this.advance();
          shadow = this.parseShadowExpr();
          break;
        case "Glow" /* Glow */:
          this.advance();
          glow = this.parseGlowExpr();
          break;
        case "Blend" /* Blend */:
          this.advance();
          blend = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Newline" /* Newline */:
          this.advance();
          break;
        default:
          throw new Error(`Line ${this.peek().line}: Invalid text property '${this.peek().kind}'`);
      }
      this.skipNewlines();
    }
    this.expect("Dedent" /* Dedent */);
    if (!pos || !content) throw new Error("Text requires 'pos [x, y]' and 'content <expr>'");
    return { type: "Text", pos, content, size, font, align, fill, stroke, width, opacity, blur, shadow, glow, blend };
  }
  parseGroup() {
    this.expect("Indent" /* Indent */);
    let pos = null, rot = null, scale = null, opacity = null, fill = null, stroke = null;
    let blend = null, blur = null, shadow = null, glow = null;
    const body = [];
    while (this.peek().kind !== "Dedent" /* Dedent */ && this.peek().kind !== "Eof" /* Eof */) {
      switch (this.peek().kind) {
        case "Pos" /* Pos */:
          this.advance();
          pos = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Rot" /* Rot */:
          this.advance();
          rot = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Scale" /* Scale */:
          this.advance();
          scale = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Opacity" /* Opacity */:
          this.advance();
          opacity = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Fill" /* Fill */:
          this.advance();
          fill = this.parsePaintExpr();
          break;
        case "Stroke" /* Stroke */:
          this.advance();
          stroke = this.parsePaintExpr();
          break;
        case "Blend" /* Blend */:
          this.advance();
          blend = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Blur" /* Blur */:
          this.advance();
          blur = this.parseExpression();
          break;
        case "Shadow" /* Shadow */:
          this.advance();
          shadow = this.parseShadowExpr();
          break;
        case "Glow" /* Glow */:
          this.advance();
          glow = this.parseGlowExpr();
          break;
        case "Newline" /* Newline */:
          this.advance();
          break;
        default:
          body.push(this.parseStatement());
          break;
      }
      this.skipNewlines();
    }
    this.expect("Dedent" /* Dedent */);
    return { type: "Group", pos, rot, scale, opacity, fill, stroke, body, blend, blur, shadow, glow };
  }
  parseClip() {
    this.expect("Indent" /* Indent */);
    const stmts = [];
    while (this.peek().kind !== "Dedent" /* Dedent */ && this.peek().kind !== "Eof" /* Eof */) {
      if (this.peek().kind === "Newline" /* Newline */) {
        this.advance();
        continue;
      }
      stmts.push(this.parseStatement());
      this.skipNewlines();
    }
    this.expect("Dedent" /* Dedent */);
    if (stmts.length === 0) throw new Error("clip block requires a mask shape as first statement");
    const maskType = stmts[0].type;
    if (!["Circle", "Ellipse", "Rectangle", "Line", "Polygon", "Path", "Text"].includes(maskType)) {
      throw new Error(`clip mask must be a geometric shape, found '${maskType}'`);
    }
    return { type: "Clip", mask: stmts[0], content: stmts.slice(1) };
  }
  parseExpression() {
    return this.parseTernary();
  }
  parseTernary() {
    const cond = this.parseLogicalOr();
    if (this.match("?" /* Question */)) {
      const trueBranch = this.parseExpression();
      this.expect(":" /* Colon */);
      const falseBranch = this.parseExpression();
      return { type: "Ternary", cond, trueBranch, falseBranch };
    }
    return cond;
  }
  parseLogicalOr() {
    let left = this.parseLogicalAnd();
    while (this.match("or" /* Or */)) {
      const right = this.parseLogicalAnd();
      left = { type: "Binary", op: "or", left, right };
    }
    return left;
  }
  parseLogicalAnd() {
    let left = this.parseEquality();
    while (this.match("and" /* And */)) {
      const right = this.parseEquality();
      left = { type: "Binary", op: "and", left, right };
    }
    return left;
  }
  parseEquality() {
    let left = this.parseComparison();
    while (this.peek().kind === "==" /* EqualEqual */ || this.peek().kind === "!=" /* NotEqual */) {
      const op = this.advance().value;
      const right = this.parseComparison();
      left = { type: "Binary", op, left, right };
    }
    return left;
  }
  parseComparison() {
    let left = this.parseAdditive();
    while (this.peek().kind === "<" /* Less */ || this.peek().kind === "<=" /* LessEqual */ || this.peek().kind === ">" /* Greater */ || this.peek().kind === ">=" /* GreaterEqual */) {
      const op = this.advance().value;
      const right = this.parseAdditive();
      left = { type: "Binary", op, left, right };
    }
    return left;
  }
  parseAdditive() {
    let left = this.parseMultiplicative();
    while (this.peek().kind === "+" /* Plus */ || this.peek().kind === "-" /* Minus */) {
      const op = this.advance().value;
      const right = this.parseMultiplicative();
      left = { type: "Binary", op, left, right };
    }
    return left;
  }
  parseMultiplicative() {
    let left = this.parsePower();
    while (this.peek().kind === "*" /* Star */ || this.peek().kind === "/" /* Slash */ || this.peek().kind === "%" /* Percent */) {
      const op = this.advance().value;
      const right = this.parsePower();
      left = { type: "Binary", op, left, right };
    }
    return left;
  }
  parsePower() {
    const left = this.parseUnary();
    if (this.match("^" /* Caret */)) {
      const right = this.parsePower();
      return { type: "Binary", op: "^", left, right };
    }
    return left;
  }
  parseUnary() {
    if (this.match("-" /* Minus */)) {
      return { type: "Unary", op: "neg", inner: this.parseUnary() };
    }
    if (this.match("not" /* Not */)) {
      return { type: "Unary", op: "not", inner: this.parseUnary() };
    }
    return this.parsePrimary();
  }
  parsePrimary() {
    const tok = this.advance();
    switch (tok.kind) {
      case "Number" /* Number */:
        return { type: "Number", value: tok.value };
      case "String" /* String */:
        return { type: "String", value: tok.value };
      case "Color" /* Color */:
        return { type: "Color", value: tok.value };
      case "[" /* LBracket */: {
        const first = this.parseExpression();
        if (this.peek().kind !== "," /* Comma */) {
          this.expect("]" /* RBracket */);
          return { type: "Array", items: [first] };
        }
        const items = [first];
        while (this.peek().kind === "," /* Comma */) {
          this.advance();
          if (this.peek().kind === "]" /* RBracket */) break;
          items.push(this.parseExpression());
        }
        this.expect("]" /* RBracket */);
        const isCompound = (e) => e.type === "Vec2" || e.type === "Array";
        if (items.length === 2 && !items.some(isCompound)) {
          const [x, y] = items;
          return { type: "Vec2", x, y };
        }
        return { type: "Array", items };
      }
      case "(" /* LParen */: {
        const expr = this.parseExpression();
        this.expect(")" /* RParen */);
        return expr;
      }
      default: {
        const name = softIdentKind(tok.kind, tok.value);
        if (name === null) {
          throw new Error(`Line ${tok.line}: Unexpected token in expression '${tok.kind}'`);
        }
        if (name === "true") return { type: "Bool", value: true };
        if (name === "false") return { type: "Bool", value: false };
        if (this.match("(" /* LParen */)) {
          const args = [];
          if (this.peek().kind !== ")" /* RParen */) {
            while (true) {
              args.push(this.parseExpression());
              if (this.peek().kind === "," /* Comma */) {
                this.advance();
              } else {
                break;
              }
            }
          }
          this.expect(")" /* RParen */);
          return { type: "Call", name, args };
        }
        return { type: "Ident", name };
      }
    }
  }
};

// src/transform.ts
var Transform2D = class _Transform2D {
  constructor(a = 1, b = 0, c = 0, d = 1, tx = 0, ty = 0) {
    this.a = a;
    this.b = b;
    this.c = c;
    this.d = d;
    this.tx = tx;
    this.ty = ty;
  }
  a;
  b;
  c;
  d;
  tx;
  ty;
  static identity() {
    return new _Transform2D(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
  }
  mul(o) {
    return new _Transform2D(
      this.a * o.a + this.c * o.b,
      this.b * o.a + this.d * o.b,
      this.a * o.c + this.c * o.d,
      this.b * o.c + this.d * o.d,
      this.a * o.tx + this.c * o.ty + this.tx,
      this.b * o.tx + this.d * o.ty + this.ty
    );
  }
  transformPoint(p) {
    return [
      this.a * p[0] + this.c * p[1] + this.tx,
      this.b * p[0] + this.d * p[1] + this.ty
    ];
  }
};

// src/evaluator.ts
var MAX_CALL_STACK_DEPTH = 64;
var MAX_SCENE_PRIMITIVES = 5e4;
function solidPaint(color) {
  return { kind: "color", color };
}
var MASK64 = 0xffffffffffffffffn;
var U64_MAX_F64 = 18446744073709552e3;
function mulmod(a, b) {
  return a * b & MASK64;
}
function hashLattice2d(ix, iy) {
  let h = mulmod(BigInt.asUintN(64, BigInt(ix)), 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15n);
  h = (h ^ mulmod(BigInt.asUintN(64, BigInt(iy)), 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9n)) & MASK64;
  h = (h ^ h >> 30n) & MASK64;
  h = mulmod(h, 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9n);
  h = (h ^ h >> 27n) & MASK64;
  h = mulmod(h, 0x94d049bb133111ebn);
  h = (h ^ h >> 31n) & MASK64;
  return Number(h) / U64_MAX_F64;
}
function hashLattice3d(ix, iy, iz) {
  let h = mulmod(BigInt.asUintN(64, BigInt(ix)), 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15n);
  h = (h ^ mulmod(BigInt.asUintN(64, BigInt(iy)), 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9n)) & MASK64;
  h = (h ^ mulmod(BigInt.asUintN(64, BigInt(iz)), 0x94d049bb133111ebn)) & MASK64;
  h = (h ^ h >> 30n) & MASK64;
  h = mulmod(h, 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9n);
  h = (h ^ h >> 27n) & MASK64;
  h = mulmod(h, 0x94d049bb133111ebn);
  h = (h ^ h >> 31n) & MASK64;
  return Number(h) / U64_MAX_F64;
}
function smooth(t) {
  return t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
}
function pvgNoise2(x, y) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(x) || !Number.isFinite(y)) return 0;
  const x0 = Math.floor(x);
  const y0 = Math.floor(y);
  const fx = x - x0;
  const fy = y - y0;
  const a = hashLattice2d(x0, y0);
  const b = hashLattice2d(x0 + 1, y0);
  const c = hashLattice2d(x0, y0 + 1);
  const d = hashLattice2d(x0 + 1, y0 + 1);
  const ux = smooth(fx);
  const uy = smooth(fy);
  const v = a + (b - a) * ux + (c - a) * uy + (a - b - c + d) * ux * uy;
  return v * 2 - 1;
}
function pvgNoise3(x, y, z) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(x) || !Number.isFinite(y) || !Number.isFinite(z)) return 0;
  const x0 = Math.floor(x);
  const y0 = Math.floor(y);
  const z0 = Math.floor(z);
  const fx = x - x0;
  const fy = y - y0;
  const fz = z - z0;
  const ux = smooth(fx);
  const uy = smooth(fy);
  const uz = smooth(fz);
  const c000 = hashLattice3d(x0, y0, z0);
  const c100 = hashLattice3d(x0 + 1, y0, z0);
  const c010 = hashLattice3d(x0, y0 + 1, z0);
  const c110 = hashLattice3d(x0 + 1, y0 + 1, z0);
  const c001 = hashLattice3d(x0, y0, z0 + 1);
  const c101 = hashLattice3d(x0 + 1, y0, z0 + 1);
  const c011 = hashLattice3d(x0, y0 + 1, z0 + 1);
  const c111 = hashLattice3d(x0 + 1, y0 + 1, z0 + 1);
  const x00 = c000 + (c100 - c000) * ux;
  const x10 = c010 + (c110 - c010) * ux;
  const x01 = c001 + (c101 - c001) * ux;
  const x11 = c011 + (c111 - c011) * ux;
  const y0v = x00 + (x10 - x00) * uy;
  const y1v = x01 + (x11 - x01) * uy;
  const v = y0v + (y1v - y0v) * uz;
  return v * 2 - 1;
}
function splineToBezier(points) {
  const n = points.length;
  if (n < 2) return [];
  if (n === 2) {
    return [[points[0], points[0], points[1]]];
  }
  const out = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
    const p0 = i === 0 ? points[0] : points[i - 1];
    const p1 = points[i];
    const p2 = points[i + 1];
    const p3 = i + 2 < n ? points[i + 2] : points[n - 1];
    const c1 = [p1[0] + (p2[0] - p0[0]) / 6, p1[1] + (p2[1] - p0[1]) / 6];
    const c2 = [p2[0] - (p3[0] - p1[0]) / 6, p2[1] - (p3[1] - p1[1]) / 6];
    out.push([c1, c2, p2]);
  }
  return out;
}
function isArrayValue(v) {
  return Array.isArray(v);
}
function clonePaint(p) {
  if (p.kind === "color") {
    const c = p.color;
    return { kind: "color", color: new PvgColor(c.r, c.g, c.b, c.a, c.isNone) };
  }
  if (p.kind === "pattern") {
    return { kind: "pattern", name: p.name };
  }
  const stops = p.stops.map((s) => ({
    offset: s.offset,
    color: new PvgColor(s.color.r, s.color.g, s.color.b, s.color.a, s.color.isNone)
  }));
  if (p.kind === "linear") {
    return {
      kind: "linear",
      start: [p.start[0], p.start[1]],
      end: [p.end[0], p.end[1]],
      stops
    };
  }
  if (p.kind === "radial") {
    return {
      kind: "radial",
      center: [p.center[0], p.center[1]],
      radius: p.radius,
      focal: p.focal ? [p.focal[0], p.focal[1]] : null,
      stops
    };
  }
  return {
    kind: "angular",
    center: [p.center[0], p.center[1]],
    startAngle: p.startAngle,
    stops
  };
}
function defaultStyle() {
  return {
    fill: solidPaint(PvgColor.Black()),
    stroke: solidPaint(PvgColor.None()),
    width: 1,
    opacity: 1,
    // PVG 0.2 Section 8/10/12 defaults
    cap: "butt",
    join: "miter",
    miter: 4,
    dash: [],
    strokeAlign: "center",
    blend: "normal",
    blur: 0,
    shadow: null,
    glow: null
  };
}
function cloneStyle(s) {
  return {
    fill: clonePaint(s.fill),
    stroke: clonePaint(s.stroke),
    width: s.width,
    opacity: s.opacity,
    cap: s.cap,
    join: s.join,
    miter: s.miter,
    dash: [...s.dash],
    strokeAlign: s.strokeAlign,
    blend: s.blend,
    blur: s.blur,
    shadow: s.shadow ? {
      offset: [s.shadow.offset[0], s.shadow.offset[1]],
      radius: s.shadow.radius,
      color: new PvgColor(
        s.shadow.color.r,
        s.shadow.color.g,
        s.shadow.color.b,
        s.shadow.color.a,
        s.shadow.color.isNone
      )
    } : null,
    glow: s.glow ? {
      radius: s.glow.radius,
      color: new PvgColor(
        s.glow.color.r,
        s.glow.color.g,
        s.glow.color.b,
        s.glow.color.a,
        s.glow.color.isNone
      )
    } : null
  };
}

  /** Clears a host override so the document default applies again. */

  /** Pushes one top-level draw command, enforcing the scene primitive budget (Section 15). */

  currentTransform() {

  }

  nextRandom() {
    this.rngState ^= this.rngState << 13n & 0xffffffffffffffffn;
    this.rngState ^= this.rngState >> 7n & 0xffffffffffffffffn;
    this.rngState ^= this.rngState << 17n & 0xffffffffffffffffn;
    return Number(this.rngState & 0xffffffffffffffffn) / Number(0xffffffffffffffffn);

  /** Rounds one coordinate to the active pixel grid (`canvas snap`, 0 = off). */
  snapVal(v) {
    if (this.snap > 0 && Number.isFinite(v)) {
      return Math.round(v / this.snap) * this.snap;
    }
    return v;
  }
  /** Rounds a point to the pixel grid after the world transform. */

    return [this.snapVal(p[0]), this.snapVal(p[1])];
  }
  /**
   * Evaluates a parsed document in the order the Rust engine does (Section 18.1/Section 18.4):
   * (1) snap + pattern names, (2) host uniforms, (3) pattern tiles, (4) body.
   */
  evaluateDocument(doc) {
    this.snap = doc.canvas.snap;
    this.patternNames = doc.patterns.map((p) => p.name);
    for (const param of doc.params) {
      if (!this.globals.has(param.name)) {
        this.globals.set(param.name, this.evalExpr(param.default, /* @__PURE__ */ new Map()));
      }
    }
    const evaluatedPatterns = [];

      canvasHeight: doc.canvas.height,

  evalStmt(stmt, locals) {
    switch (stmt.type) {
      case "Set": {
        const val = this.evalExpr(stmt.expr, locals);
        if (locals.has(stmt.name)) {
          locals.set(stmt.name, val);
        } else {
          this.globals.set(stmt.name, val);
        }
        return null;
      }
      case "Seed": {
        const s = BigInt(stmt.seed);
        this.rngState = s === 0n ? 88172645463325252n : s;
        return null;
      }
      case "Def":
        this.functions.set(stmt.name, { params: stmt.params, body: stmt.body });
        return null;
      case "Return":
        return { isReturn: true, value: this.evalExpr(stmt.expr, locals) };
      case "For": {
        const startVal = this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(stmt.from, locals));
        const endVal = this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(stmt.to, locals));
        const stepVal = stmt.step ? this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(stmt.step, locals)) : endVal >= startVal ? 1 : -1;
        if (stepVal === 0) throw new Error("For loop step cannot be 0");
        let current = startVal;
        while (stepVal > 0 && current <= endVal || stepVal < 0 && current >= endVal) {
          this.loopCount++;
          if (this.loopCount > this.loopLimit) {
            throw new Error(`Exceeded safety loop limit of ${this.loopLimit} iterations`);
          }
          locals.set(stmt.var, current);
          for (const bStmt of stmt.body) {
            const ret = this.evalStmt(bStmt, locals);
            if (ret && ret.isReturn) return ret;
          }
          current += stepVal;
        }
        return null;
      }
      case "While": {
        while (this.isTruthy(this.evalExpr(stmt.cond, locals))) {
          this.loopCount++;
          if (this.loopCount > this.loopLimit) {
            throw new Error(`Exceeded safety loop limit of ${this.loopLimit} iterations`);
          }
          for (const bStmt of stmt.body) {
            const ret = this.evalStmt(bStmt, locals);
            if (ret && ret.isReturn) return ret;
          }
        }
        return null;
      }
      case "If": {
        if (this.isTruthy(this.evalExpr(stmt.cond, locals))) {
          for (const bStmt of stmt.thenBody) {
            const ret = this.evalStmt(bStmt, locals);
            if (ret && ret.isReturn) return ret;
          }
        } else {
          for (const bStmt of stmt.elseBody) {
            const ret = this.evalStmt(bStmt, locals);
            if (ret && ret.isReturn) return ret;
          }
        }
        return null;
      }
      case "Call": {

        this.invokeFunction(stmt.name, evalArgs);

      }
      case "Circle": {

      }
      case "Ellipse": {

        if (stmt.fill) style.fill = this.asPaint(this.evalExpr(stmt.fill, locals));
        if (stmt.stroke) style.stroke = this.asPaint(this.evalExpr(stmt.stroke, locals));
        if (stmt.width) style.width = this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(stmt.width, locals));
        if (stmt.opacity) style.opacity *= this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(stmt.opacity, locals));

      case "Path": {

        if (stmt.stroke) style.stroke = this.asPaint(this.evalExpr(stmt.stroke, locals));
        if (stmt.width) style.width = this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(stmt.width, locals));
        if (stmt.opacity) style.opacity *= this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(stmt.opacity, locals));

      }
      case "Group": {

          const sin = Math.sin(angle);
          localTrans = localTrans.mul(new Transform2D(cos, sin, -sin, cos, 0, 0));

        this.transformStack.push(newTrans);
        const style = this.currentStyle();
        if (stmt.fill) style.fill = this.asPaint(this.evalExpr(stmt.fill, locals));
        if (stmt.stroke) style.stroke = this.asPaint(this.evalExpr(stmt.stroke, locals));
        if (stmt.opacity) style.opacity *= this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(stmt.opacity, locals));
        if (stmt.blend) style.blend = this.evalBlend(this.evalExpr(stmt.blend, locals));

      }
      case "Sprite": {
        const posRaw = this.asVec2(this.evalExpr(stmt.pos, locals));
        const palette = [];
        for (const entry of stmt.palette) {

        }
        const scale = stmt.scale ? Math.max(0.01, this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(stmt.scale, locals))) : 1;
        const style = this.currentStyle();
        style.fill = solidPaint(PvgColor.White());
        style.stroke = solidPaint(PvgColor.None());
        if (stmt.opacity) style.opacity *= this.asNumber(this.evalExpr(stmt.opacity, locals));

        return null;
      }
      case "Spline": {
        const raw = this.evalExpr(stmt.points, locals);

        const ctrl = [];

        if (hasVec) {
          for (const v of items) {
            if (Array.isArray(v)) {
              if (v.length === 2 && typeof v[0] === "number" && typeof v[1] === "number") {
                ctrl.push([v[0], v[1]]);
              } else {
                throw new Error("Spline points must be [x, y] vectors or numbers.");
              }
            } else if (typeof v === "number") {
              ctrl.push([ctrl.length, v]);
            } else {
              throw new Error("Spline points must be [x, y] vectors or numbers.");
            }
          }
        } else {

          if (n === 0) throw new Error("Spline requires at least one point.");
          const nums = items.map((v) => this.asNumber(v));

          for (const v of nums) {
            lo = Math.min(lo, v);
            hi = Math.max(hi, v);
          }
          if (!(hi > lo)) hi = lo + 1;
          for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const t = n > 1 ? i / (n - 1) : 0;
            const y = oy + (1 - (nums[i] - lo) / (hi - lo)) * sh;
            ctrl.push([ox + t * sw, y]);
          }
        }
        if (ctrl.length === 1) ctrl.push([ctrl[0][0], ctrl[0][1]]);
        const style = this.currentStyle();
        style.stroke = stmt.stroke ? this.asPaint(this.evalExpr(stmt.stroke, locals)) : solidPaint(PvgColor.White());
